# netactuate_platform_datacenters (Data Source)

Reads Platform Datacenters visible to the account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netactuate_platform_datacenters" "example" {
  location = "example"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `location` (String) Location whose platform datacenters will be listed. This accepts the location value accepted by the API.

### Read-Only

- `datacenters` (List of Object) Datacenters returned by the API. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--datacenters))
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedatt--datacenters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `datacenters`

Read-Only:

- `datacenter_id` (Number)
- `iata_code` (String)
- `location` (String)
- `name` (String)
